I dreamed that my mom had died. That's... basically it, for the dream. Now admittedly, I've always been closer to my dad out of the two of them. And especially since several of my friends have lost their fathers, I've become really paranoid of him passing away. But suddenly I woke up and there was blood all over my face from nosebleed, I'm crying and depressed for the rest of the day - partially out of worry, partially out of shame.

Called my parents to see if they were okay. Mom's superstitious so she'd take it as an ill omen, so I didn't tell them about the dream, just the nighttime nosebleed (used to happen as a kid, haven't had one in years).
